correctness.rationale: Ramras Proposition 4.9 proves this precise 1,560-sphere homotopy type, ensuring the reduced Lefschetz character equals the unique second-homology character. The strict-chain stabilizer argument and subgroup-weight inclusion recurrence give an exact character formula. All 59 subgroup closures and 1,018 cosets are exhaustively enumerated. Two independent exact methods agree on all 60 automorphisms and explicit simplex-chain traces; orthogonality yields rational constituent multiplicities 100,95,116. The included standalone program independently replays the critical finite data; no homotopy claim is inferred from finite enumeration alone.

value.rationale: This determines the complete rational A5 symmetry representation on the top homology of a historically studied canonical coset complex of the smallest nonabelian simple group. The full five-class Lefschetz character and three rational irreducible multiplicities contain strictly more information than the 1560-sphere count, and distinguish the action from 26 regular representations. The question is natural and finite but is a complete invariant, not an arbitrary numerical slice; no downstream theorem is needed for mathematical significance.
